extracted.name: Easy Beef Burgundy
extracted.description: This beef Burgundy with noodles features sirloin chunks seared until browned, then simmered in a super easy mushroom-red wine sauce until tender.
ingredient_lines: 1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed golden mushroom soup
instruction_lines: Heat a Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear beef in the hot pot until browned on all sides. Stir onion into beef and sauté until onion is golden brown.
Add mushrooms, butter, condensed soup, and wine; stir until well combined. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 2 hours.
